C.F.R. § 385.2010(c)(2), Sidley Austin LLP respectfully requests that the Commission’s official
service lists in the dockets listed below, including all subdockets, be updated to reflect the
following changes in representation for the respective parties listed below.

       In each of the dockets listed below, including all subdockets, Thomas R. Millar and
Gwendolyn A. Hicks should be removed from the official service list at each of the Winston &
Strawn LLP addresses shown above, and Thomas R. Millar of Sidley Austin LLP should be added
as counsel for the party identified for that docket. Ms. Hicks should be removed without
replacement. The party represented in each docket is unchanged.
